annotations.title: Search EU Horizon Europe Grants & SEDIA Funding Calls

description: Search open and forthcoming European Commission grants and tenders (Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, EIC, LIFE, EDF) via SEDIA API with parsed EUR topic budgets and submission deadlines (`corridordata/eu-horizon-grants-funding-calls`).

maxItems.description: Maximum EU funding calls or tenders to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

minBudgetEur.description: Minimum parsed topic budget in EUR.

opportunityTypes.description: Include EU Grants, EU Tenders, or both.

name: search_eu_horizon_grants
